rule_questions: Is a PK/PD occupancy-efficacy model fitted in the same NZB/W mice a separate track from the efficacy readouts in those mice? I treated it as the same system (one model_id).

The engagement track pools a direct readout (BTK occupancy: matched) and a downstream readout (autoantibodies: contradicted, evobrutinib). Under 'contra beats same' the cell shows contra although target engagement held; should engagement be scored per readout_tier?

The 80% occupancy target was published (Haselmayer, April 2019) after the member SLE trials started (Jan 2017) but before any readout. Does the 'stated before the trial' requirement apply to dose targets as well as to margins?

Fenebrutinib SLE regimen: the HV PK/PD model (fenebrutinib-hv-pkpd) stated the regimen, but the BTK-inhibition level it aimed at came from NZB/W mice (Isenberg 2021 dose rationale, ref 16). Does the dose target score on both the HV-model and mouse-btk-occupancy-pkpd tracks, or only one?
